audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 (Levels 4-5), 4 (Level 6) and 6 (2+ items) are labelled Skill / Skill / Maokai in both layers, but the whys[] under them say Maokai repeats trades Nautilus cannot heal, Maokai's double root beats his single hook, and that 2+ items is 'a genuine Skill standoff'. The packet chart is Skill / Maokai x5 / Skill.
audit.why: Bramble Smash is 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s against Dredge Line at 14/13/12/11/10s, so Maokai gets roughly two knockbacks per hook cycle and Sap Magic refunds the chip — Levels 4-5 and 6 are his. Nature's Grasp adds a second root on top of Twisted Advance while Depth Charge is one 120s knockup. At 2+ items both are utility tanks with no solo kill threat, which is a standoff, not a Maokai lane.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 set to Maokai, row 6 set to Skill, in both layers, with the whys rewritten to state the cooldown arithmetic.

audit.why: Four spikes present. Note spikes[3].when is 'Lvl 1-2' rather than a late window — that is deliberate here, flagging his hook-into-passive-root kill setup before Maokai has W, and it reads correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the file never names Staggering Blow, Titan's Wrath, Riptide or Depth Charge — only Dredge Line. dontsFull[1] is literally titled 'Eat his passive root chain' and its description says nothing about the passive.
audit.why: Staggering Blow roots on Nautilus's first attack against a given target, which is what converts a landed Dredge Line into a full combo. Titan's Wrath is a 12s flat-cooldown shield with attack damage-over-time, and Riptide (7/6.5/6/5.5/5s) is the chip that Sap Magic refunds. Depth Charge is a 120/100/80s single-target knockup. Naming them makes the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Staggering Blow named in dontsFull[1].d, Titan's Wrath and Riptide in phases[2].why, Depth Charge in phases[4].why, and Dredge Line's 14s rank-1 cooldown in dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dredge Line is named as the tracked cooldown everywhere but never with a duration, so 'engage on its cooldown' has no length attached.
audit.why: Dredge Line is 14/13/12/11/10s. At rank 1 that is a 14-second window, long enough for two Bramble Smash cycles.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and phases[3].why now carry the number.

edits.after: Saplings plus W-Q out-sustain Riptide's chip, and his Titan's Wrath shield only stalls — Sap Magic refunds the trade.

edits.after: Dredge Line is 14s at rank 1 and your Q is 7s, so you land two knockbacks per hook cycle and he cannot heal any of it back.

edits.after: Two utility tanks with no 1v1 kill threat — the duel stalls, so cash your lane lead into roams and objectives instead.

edits.before: His only engage. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only engage, 14s at rank 1. Commit once it is down or baited.

edits.after: Staggering Blow roots on his first auto to a target — break the chain.
